watched #LoversLoveStori :

Where to Watch : Youtube, MX Player, Hungama Play, Airtel Xstream, VI

Link : https://youtu.be/kkZNQz44gGg

Good Content and Good Screenplay!!! its never easy to start the movie at Pre-Climax part and then later start revealing the back stories especially for non thriller movies as most of the audience will start loosing intrest in whats happening on the screen and try to pre process what the climax would be!!! However with this screenplay the Directors duo of Vempati Srenivas & Venugopal Makala had made sure that to glue the audience to the current proceedings on the screen.

Vempati Srenivas & Venugopal Makala have Produced, Directed and have written Dialogues for this movie which shows their passion….

Acting wise Dhruvan katakam did a fantastic job and his character is what we instantly gets connected to. All other actors did okay considering their own limitations, Any famous/good star cast from short movies industry would have elevated the content to next level.

BGM and Song Lyrics were inline with the story and with in their limitations no where deviated from what is required. All the departments did apt job.
